items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1960-03-29
items.q: Manuel Perez. Let me see who played. Who played with Manuel? Bunk.

ctx.x: Oh, that broke up long. Buddy Johnson played trombone in that band. Yeah, that was a good band, boy. Manuel Perez. Let me see who played. Who played with Manuel? Bunk. A little buddy called Bunk. What did he play?
Trumpet. I know who he is. Dark fellow.

items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Oh, Manuel Perez. ... Oh, I said he was a wonderful trumpet player. ... No, no, he had his own band.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, uh, who was the best of all the reading musicians?
Uh, who was the best? For reading. Oh, Manuel Perez.
Manuel Perez. Yes, indeed. Well, would he play with the same tone as Bolden and Clem?
